summary: A polished Thai fine-dining dinner in Thonglor, built around a seasonal multi-course samrub that revisits regional ingredients and traditional dishes with contemporary technique. Michelin lists R-Haan at two stars for 2026. Plan this as a special-occasion, high-budget evening; the restaurant does not publish a price in the accessible current menu page.
whyGo: Experience a composed Thai tasting menu that draws on ingredients and culinary traditions from across Thailand.
Michelin highlights family-style courses, a crab-roe and yellow-chilli dip, and tom yam presented in a siphon.
bestFor: A celebratory meal or travelers seeking an extended, guided Thai fine-dining experience.
Guests comfortable with a seasonal set menu and smart, polished dress.
skipIf: You want a quick or inexpensive meal, prefer ordering freely from an à-la-carte menu, or need fully confirmed dietary substitutions before booking.
You cannot accommodate the restaurant's smart-casual dress rules, which exclude shorts, slippers, sleeveless shirts and athletic clothing.
duration: Allow about 2–3 hours for the tasting menu; this is the restaurant's general estimate, and pacing can vary.
cost: High-end (Michelin price category ฿฿฿฿). The current official page does not expose a menu price. Published prices incur 10% service charge and 7% VAT; confirm the December menu price and final total directly before booking.
hours: The restaurant lists dinner daily from 18:00 to 23:00. Reconfirm holiday-period service when reserving.
bestTime: Book an early dinner seating if you want a relaxed evening and extra time for Bangkok traffic. Seasonal menus change; ask what will be served during your date.
gettingThere: At 131 Soi Sukhumvit 53 (Paidee-Madee), Thonglor. A taxi or ride-hail directly to the address is the simplest plan; allow extra time for Sukhumvit traffic. Confirm the final approach with your driver, as the venue is inside the soi.
booking: Reserve through the restaurant's TableCheck link or contact reservation@r-haan.com / +66 95 141 5524 (listed phone hours 10:30–23:00). The official contact page states a THB 5,000 deposit for reservations of two or more and THB 10,000 for groups of four or more; confirm how the deposit applies to your party. Tell the restaurant about allergies, dietary needs, or vegetarian requests in advance. Current site says bar seating may be available to walk-ins, but reserve for the full samrub experience.
accessibility: Michelin lists air conditioning, car park and valet parking. I could not verify step-free access, accessible toilets, or other mobility provisions; contact the restaurant before booking if these matter.
practicalTips: Follow the smart-casual dress code; the restaurant asks guests to avoid shorts, sleeveless shirts, slippers and sportswear.
Ask for the final menu price, service charge/VAT total, deposit and cancellation terms when booking.
The official menu welcomes advance notice of allergies, vegetarian diets and other dietary restrictions, but confirm that your specific needs can be accommodated.
The restaurant asks guests not to use flash photography or livestream during dinner.
decemberNotes: The restaurant describes a winter seasonal samrub on its current menu page, but that does not confirm which menu or price will run in December 2026. Ask when reserving. December is a busy travel period, so book ahead and build traffic time into the evening; no special December 2026 event or holiday schedule was confirmed in the sources checked.
uncertainties: Exact December 2026 menu, price, seating availability and holiday hours are not published in the sources checked.
Accessibility details beyond parking/valet are not stated on the official contact page or Michelin listing.
Deposit, cancellation and dietary-accommodation terms should be confirmed directly for the chosen date.
